problem: T14 is titled '…resolv.conf is bound back only for network: true' but nothing asserts the network-off plan leaves resolv.conf out; the resolv.conf exists/real reads at unattended.ts:284-285 bypass the new fake-filesystem seam, and the only resolv assertion is conditional (`if (resolvIdx >= 0)`).
impact: Removing the `if (fullNetwork)` guard binds /etc/resolv.conf back into a network-off unattended run with no sandbox test failing.
suggested_fix: Assert the network-off args carry no resolv.conf; route the resolv.conf exists/real reads through the detect seam so the fake Linux filesystem declares the stub-resolv symlink and the network-on bind is asserted unconditionally.
evidence: verified — scratch-copy mutation unattended.ts:283 `if (fullNetwork) {` → `if (true) {`, `bun test src/harness/process/sandbox --timeout 30000`: 179 pass, 23 skip, 0 fail (survives).

verification.evidence: verified against commit 29dfa73d870968694fd018e4738f1c43e57319e4, contained in head 29dfa73d870968694fd018e4738f1c43e57319e4: scratch `git archive HEAD` copy, unattended.ts:284 `if (fullNetwork) {` -> `if (true) {`, `bun test src/harness/process/sandbox --timeout 30000`: 178 pass, 23 skip, 1 fail (T14 unattended.test.ts:112, network-off args include resolv); unmutated copy 179 pass, 0 fail. Production defaults hostIsDir/hostReal/hostExists to the real filesystem when detect is absent (unattended.ts:257-259).

disposition.evidence: fixed in 29dfa73d870968694fd018e4738f1c43e57319e4 (PR #827): resolv.conf reads go through the detect seam; T14 asserts network-off has no resolv bind and network-on binds the stub; verifier refuted by mutation

problem: When .git itself is a symlink, from a linked worktree git prints the target's realpath, so resolveMainCheckoutRoot returns the target's parent, not the checkout; AC2's 'same canonical common dir' does not cover that case. The test comment at git-worktrees.test.ts:113-115 records the limit.
impact: Pre-existing, not a regression: doctor/update from a linked worktree of such a repo look for .claude/worktrees beside the wrong directory.
suggested_fix: Record the limitation; a real fix would read <commonDir>/worktrees/<name>/gitdir or `git worktree list --porcelain`.
evidence: verified — probe scratchpad/r366/copy/src/probe-symgit.ts: main root=…/repo; worktree root=…/elsewhere.

disposition.evidence: decided-by: MrCipherSmith, 2026-10-01 — git limitation (linked worktree of a repo with a symlinked .git gets the target's realpath from git); pre-existing, no regression; recorded in git-worktrees.test.ts comment (report K-002)

problem: routingTrustKey = path.resolve(cwd) does not canonicalise, so an approval filed under /var/folders/… misses a lookup under /private/var/folders/…; the preload fixes the tests, not the key.
impact: Fails closed (approved routing table ignored with ROUTING_TRUST_NOTICE); the CLI uses the same location.cwd on both sides, so users hit it only via a symlinked path from one entry point.
suggested_fix: Optional: realpath in routingTrustKey with path.resolve fallback.
evidence: verified — scratch-copy mutation removing the preload's TMPDIR realpath, `bun test src/commands/review.test.ts -t 305`: 7 fail; trust.ts:51-53 read.

disposition.evidence: decided-by: MrCipherSmith, 2026-10-01 — routing trust key fails closed; CLI uses the same cwd on both sides (report K-003)

problem: The codex control-char round-trip case is skipped on hosts whose Bun.TOML.parse rejects \u0007/\u0000 escapes (bun 1.3.14); whether it runs anywhere depends on CI's bun-version: latest.
impact: If CI's Bun also rejects them, the case runs nowhere.
suggested_fix: Confirm in the CI log that the case runs, or use a version-independent TOML oracle.
evidence: verified — scratchpad/r366/toml-probe.ts on bun 1.3.14: \u0007 and \u0000 throw; `bun test compile.format-safety.test.ts -t control-char`: 3 pass, 1 skip; ci.yml:24 bun-version: latest.
